notes.title: Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream is Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Troublemakers! [/p][p]Big news — the sequel is finally here. [b]Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream has officially launched on Steam today![/b] 🎉  If you enjoyed the chaos, story, and schoolyard brawls of the original, you won’t want to miss the next chapter. Bigger fights, an open world, weirder stories, and the [i]Beyond Dream[/i] band are waiting for you in South Jayakarta.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479770/Troublemaker_2_Beyond_Dream/"][/dynamiclink]Don’t sleep on it — grab it now while it’s on [b]launch discount[/b] and be part of the next wild ride.  [/p][p][b]Dare to Dream! Beyond Dream![/b][/p][p] Stay Tune, Stay UwU 
– The Gamecom Team[/p]

notes.title: The Parakacuk gang is back!!
notes.content:
[p][b]We are so excited to announce that the Parakacuk gang is back in Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream, and we're  launching September 15 on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="aeU4lnorcXE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Set two years after the events of the Troublemaker, Budi, Jordan and the Parakacuk crew return — this time joined by the [i]Beyond Dream[/i] band — for a chaotic new chapter of dreams, drugs, and street fights in South Jayakarta.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What can you expect in Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream?[/b] [/h2][p]
🎸[b]Yes, you can play in the band: [/b]You’re not just throwing punches — you're also rocking out with the [i]Beyond Dream[/i] band. Expect rhythm-based segments, music-infused storytelling, and some wild concert scenes that hit just as hard as the fights. Because chasing your dreams sometimes means hitting the stage.[/p][p][/p][p]🏙️ [b]A bigger, denser South Jayakarta[/b] – Packed with [i]absurd side stories[/i], [i]city activities[/i], and a whole bunch of [b]ridiculous mini-games[/b]. (Yes, they’re even more unhinged than the last time.)[/p][p]🎭 [b]A wild and weird narrative[/b] – Set two years after the first game, the story dives into [i]dreams, drugs, and chasing meaning[/i] with the Parakacuk gang and the “Beyond Dream” band.[/p][p]👊 [b]Two playable characters, two fighting styles[/b] – Jordan and Budi bring their own flavor of chaos to an upgraded combat system that hits harder and plays smoother.[/p][p]💬 [b]Signature Gamecom satire[/b] – The local comedy and sharp commentary are back and just as loud as ever.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ve grown. So has the game.[/b][/p][p]We heard your feedback on [i]Troublemaker[/i]. [b]Troublemaker 2: [i]Beyond Dream[/i][/b] is the sequel we dreamed of making — bigger, more polished, more absurd, and 100% powered by what we learned from you! If you liked the original, you’re going to love what’s coming September 15. Explore a packed open world full of absurd side quests, upgraded combat, unhinged mini-games, and playable band segments.
[b]It’s bigger, bolder, and more trouble than ever.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]💥 [b]Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game on Steam[/b] – it’s one of the best ways to support us and make sure you’re notified as soon as the game drops.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479770/Troublemaker_2_Beyond_Dream/"][/dynamiclink]Until September 15....[/p][p]Dare to Dream! Beyond Dream!  
Stay Tune, Stay UwU  [/p][p]-The Gamecom Team [/p]

notes.title: December Update!
notes.content:
Hey Troublemakers!

We’re back again with another developer update!

Since class was last in session, we have completed all chapters of the story! We’re really excited for you all to experience it and we can’t wait for you to see it and tell us what you think!

We’ve also added difficulty settings that can changed at anytime in the gameplay settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/d06185a11488ddff33a258ed57c7b06bf16b5392.png[/img]

We’ve also added more advanced graphic settings (and there’s no need to restart the game every time you change them 😉)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/85bd944994ca3026a97ca2b25b9447c78e137641.png[/img]

Post-game scenes and end-credit content have also been completed. We can’t wait for you to see them!

In other news, we were also nominated in The Lazy Game Awards, an annual award ceremony for the Indonesian gaming community. The three categories we were nominated for were:

Indonesian Most Ancitipated Games 2022
Best Indonesian Game Developer
Indonesian Most Influential Person in Gaming

We won the Indonesian Most Anticipated Games 2022, and we could not be more excited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/7ff2900c5a8fa03ec64637482ac6c4c59e4c2789.png[/img]

We promise to work hard to live up to your expectations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/796ed27752a89c5e33d59f5f66e89a0dea0fea0f.png[/img]

We’re super duper excited for you all to see what we’ve been up to and working on, so don’t forget to check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/gxWfzgn3fE]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://twitter.com/GamecomTeam]Twitter[/url] for more sneak peeks 😉 We’ll see you all at school, troublemakers! Stay tuned, Stay UwU

notes.title: November Dev Update!
notes.content:
Hey Troublemakers!

We’re back again with another developer update!

Since class was last in session, we have completed some super duper cool card minigames.

Here’s a sneak peek at one of them:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/89be32668fb1ecc98098aea2fd59b2d5550a434b.gif[/img]



A little about the game:

Each player is given 8 random cards.
Cards have 2 types. Attack cards are red and Defend cards are blue.
Attack cards will reduce enemy points at that location based on the card’s points.
Defensive cards will add player points at that location based on the card’s points.
The game ends when all the cards on both sides have been used.
The winner is whoever has the highest points in 2 or 3 sections out of the 3 sections!

We’ve also added a new super secret sick move and we can’t wait for you to see it. It’s so super secret that we shouldn’t give you a sneak peek…buuut… 👀

(Here’s a screenshot anyway! 🥳 )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/c77432c6a837a5c3f86779eecd30244149403bed.png[/img]

You can buy all of these in the shop. Don’t spend all of your money at once, hehe!

We have some surprises coming up so we don’t want to spoil it all - but we’ve completed the last chapter of the game! We can’t wait for you to see it and tell us what you think!

We’re super duper excited for you all to see what we’ve been up to and working on, so don’t forget to check out our Discord and follow us on our socials for more sneak peeks 😉 We’ll see you all at school, troublemakers! Stay tuned, Stay UwU

notes.title: Rebrand Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

School’s back in session so Parakacuk is over. We just can’t support disappointing your parents like this any longer 😭

Just kidding! Parakacuk is being rebranded into Troublemaker! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/0070b565aa437aa11a849055f12a5826d6001535.png[/img]

But guys, why the rebrand?
Well, the game won’t be changing one bit! However, we wanted to go with a more internationally friendly name, as Parakacuk may be difficult for our non-Indonesian friends to pronounce. Parakacuk means “Chaos Maker”, so we thought “Troublemaker” would fit it perfectly!

That’s not all the news we have for you today!

We are also super excited to introduce to you our IndieGoGo! We’ll have a ton of rewards, tier options, and goals for you to check out. Check us out here: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/troublemaker/coming_soon

Don’t forget, if you want to join our community and interact with us, hit us up on [url=https://discord.gg/gxWfzgn3fE]Discord [/url]and [url=https://twitter.com/GamecomTeam]Twitter[/url].

We’ll see you all at school, troublemakers! Stay Tune Stay UwU

notes.title: Publisher Announcement 👀
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are proud to announce that Parakacuk is now being published by Freedom Games ( https://freedom.gg ). For those of you who may not know, a game publisher can take care of a lot of the business and marketing side of releasing a game. That includes managing our store pages, marketing and advertising the game, helping showcase the game at both digital and live events, PR, and a lot more. Really it lets us totally focus on working to make the game the best it can be, and provides us with the resources to do so. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/fe7a49ccc301e05200d3cc1ca13ee3e7ec216856.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your support so far throughout development! We have a lot more awesome stuff coming soon for you all that we will get to showcase soon 👀Definitely stay tuned for more, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/6qhGjbBNeJ]Discord [/url]where we have some other cool things happening as well. UwU
